tasks.title: Commit belt keeps the context ledger fresh
tasks.objective: A git commit issued through an agent session re-scans the context inbox in-process, stages the refreshed ledger so its diff rides the same commit, and denies the commit while any context file is refused - killing the stale-ledger red-CI class (minegate PR #69) at its source.
acceptance_criteria: scan_inbox(base) -> (drift, refused) is factored out of cmd_scan in forge_cli/context.py: it mutates and saves the ledger, prints nothing, never exits; cmd_scan wraps it with byte-identical output.

pre_tool_use.py gains a commit belt after root = repo_root(): on Bash commands whose git_subcommand() is 'commit', it calls scan_inbox(root); refused -> deny() with the refusal lines; drift -> stage docs/context/ledger.json via subprocess and fall through to allow; clean inbox -> pure pass-through.
Hook stdout stays exactly the decision JSON (no scan output pollution).

The write-time PostToolUse hook is recorded in plans/deferrals.md via forge defer add with the trigger from the plan; the two factual spec amendments, the roadmap AC1 rewording, and the docs/context/README sentence land.
check_dual_runtime.py and the full gate suite stay green with zero hook-registration changes.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "commit_belt or context_scan or unscanned"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Hook JSON protocol purity on stdout; the index mutation is bounded to exactly docs/context/ledger.json and only after a successful scan; cmd_scan output stays byte-identical after the scan_inbox factoring; the belt sits after root=repo_root(), never in the early denylist.
